summary: 完整组合在200与600+500场景的三组配对均通过原始CPU与整帧P95门槛，默认采用0.5秒/六候选/共享索引/保守零缓存/三倍转向；独立避障及旧避障加三倍转向在压力场景未全通过，不宣称这些组合已通过。

stress_scenario.plan_deviation: One of the originally planned four source domains was already retired; all twenty stress windows use the current three production sources. The original four-domain scenario has not been validated.

scope: Only the complete combination is adopted on this evidence; independent switches permit rollback but altered combinations require their own validation.
limitations: Near-zero cache hit counts do not establish a measurable cache-only benefit.
Shared immutable geometry is consistent within each version; moving geometry still causes frequent version publication and grid builds.
Stress windows with zero real muzzle births establish CPU/network diagnostics, not complete client presentation benefit.
Wall/corridor/congestion feel and WM01 visual acceptance remain available in the original map entry for player review.
Same-process dedicated server and two clients do not establish standalone client FPS.
